nodes.label: ADR-004: Server-Sent Events for Real-Time Metric Streaming
Server-Sent Events metric streaming (/metrics/stream)
nodes.rationale: Chosen over WebSocket and client polling because metric streaming is strictly unidirectional server-to-client: EventSource is native with built-in exponential-backoff reconnect, works over one long-lived HTTP response through HTTP/2 multiplexing with no handshake, and Fastify's reply.raw streams it without extra plugins. Cookie auth (withCredentials + HttpOnly access cookie) keeps tokens out of URLs; named 'metrics' events avoid onmessage catching unnamed traffic. The server polls VictoriaMetrics once every 5s and broadcasts to all subscribers rather than each client polling. Trade-offs accepted: text-only (no binary framing), 6-connections-per-origin browser limit, and a need for sticky sessions (nginx cookie affinity) behind a load balancer. Binary telemetry payloads would be the trigger to revisit.
